en.title: Maximum Palindromic Strings After Arbitrary Swaps
en.description:
You may swap any two characters any number of times, including swaps within the same string. Each string keeps its length. Maximize the final number of palindromic strings.

This site uses a standard input/output protocol; missing numeric ranges are stated explicitly.
en.input: The first line contains N, followed by N lines of non-empty lowercase strings. The original source has no numeric ranges; this site uses 1≤N≤100000 and a total of ≤1000000 characters.
en.output: Output a single integer, the answer.
en.explanation: Example 1: the four characters are all different, so there are no matching pairs; the answer is 0. Example 2: rearrange into aa and bb; the answer is 2. Example 3: rearrange into aba and c; the answer is 2.
hints: Count how many pairs of identical characters all the characters together can provide, then spend this budget on the strings in ascending order of their demand floor(length/2).
